description: This file defines an Angular standalone component named SidebarComponent, which manages navigation filters such as 'all', 'pinned', 'archived', and tags for a notes application. It emits events when filters change to notify parent components.

classes.name: SidebarComponent
classes.description: A standalone Angular component for sidebar navigation and filtering notes.

methods.name: triggerCreate
methods.description: Placeholder for future extension to handle note creation from the sidebar.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Sets the filter based on user selection ('all', 'pinned', 'archived') and emits corresponding filter change events.

methods.name: applyTag
methods.description: Filters notes by a specific tag and emits the filter change event.
